### Problem

A frequent cause of a review's major, and so of a fix round, is documentation left out of step with the code: a renamed input, flag, label or file still named in docs/, a workflow's header comment, a pack or the README, or a description that no longer says what the diff does. AGENTS.md asks for them in the same pull request, but only the model checks it, at review time, after the code is written (#942 needed several rounds for it on 2026-11-22). Nothing deterministic catches it while the agent codes.

### Scope

- A documentation check in the same gate as the security tools (it runs in `make pre-pr`, in the pull request's check, and its result goes to the review's brief), under the same setting (`off | report | block`).
- What it checks, from git, with no model: an identifier the change removes or renames (a workflow input, an output, a job or step id, a script's command or flag, an environment variable, a label, a file path) that the docs, the workflow header comments, the packs or the README still name; and a code path changed while none of the docs that a map (data, per kind and per repository) names for it changed, unless the description says why none needed changing.
- Its report to the agent is cut like the security gate's, and the autopilot's attempts at the same finding are capped the same way.
- Docs and tests in step.

### Out of scope

- Whether a text explains well: that stays the review's.
- The security tools (#956) and the impact map.

### Acceptance criteria

- C1: Given a change that renames a workflow input, a script's flag or a label, when the check runs, then it names every doc, header comment, pack or README line that still has the old name.
- C2: Given a change to a code path that the map ties to docs, when none of those docs changed and the description does not say why, then the check names the docs to update.
- C3: Given the description explains why no doc needed changing, when the check runs, then that path passes.
- C4: Given `report`, `block` or `off`, when the check finds something, then it behaves as the security gate does under the same setting.

### Criticality

Critical
